+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The decoder layer's blocks, each one persistent launch, ``BLOCKS`` x
+``THREADS``, S <= ``MAX_TOKENS`` rows:
+
+    gdn    (``linear_attn`` up to out_proj's input): x [S, H] -> in_proj_qkvz
+           (MXFP4) / in_proj_ba -> conv1d -> the gated delta rule -> the
+           sigmoid-gated norm -> core [S, CORE]
+    oproj  (``out_proj`` / ``o_proj``, its TP all-reduce and the attention
+           HC's combine): core (x sigmoid(gate)) -> bf16 partials -> every
+           rank's AR -> the next state [S, HC H] and its sums of squares
+    moe    (``mlp``, its TP all-reduce and the MLP HC's combine): x [S, H] ->
+           router, sigmoid shared gate, top-10, the MXFP4 experts with the
+           shared expert fused as expert 512 -> every rank's FINAL -> the next
+           state and its sums of squares
+
+The combine (``hc.stage_combine``) runs in the all-reduce epilogue: the ranks'
+bf16 partials summed in rank order in fp32 -> bf16 block output; state_k +
+block 2 sigmoid(inj_k / 4) -> the next state, as ``GatedResidual.combine``
+rounds it, so the next ``front.hc_front`` reads a plain state and its norm's
+sums of squares. A launch's input is a previous launch's output (plain loads).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64, T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono import hc
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono import mx_layout as QL
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.debug import region_ids
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    ld_i32,
+    load_ptr64,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    KernelAbi,
+    key_tuple,
+    pair_layout,
+    source_digest,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ranks import peer_bases
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    Mailbox,
+    preg,
+    shift,
+    sreg,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import need
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import gdn as G
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import gemv, moe
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import in_proj as P
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import router as R
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.gdn import (
+    NVCH,
+    VCH,
+    gdn_tasks,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.moe import (
+    PS_MIN,
+    quant_x,
+    sigmoid,
+    step_tag,
+)
+
+H, ROWS, HD = L.HIDDEN, L.ROWS, L.HD
+E, TOPK, KT = L.E, L.TOPK, R.KT
+OTASKS = H // ROWS  # 160: o_proj / down row groups, CTAs 0 ..
+COLS = 128  # output columns a reduction task
+NRED = H // COLS  # 20
+R0 = OTASKS  # 160: router CTAs
+RT0 = R0 + E // ROWS  # 192: shared gate CTAs, a token each
+MAXT = L.MAX_TOKENS
+PS0 = RT0 + MAXT  # 208: the fused shared expert's early ug CTAs
+XROW = H + gemv.LDS_PAD
+# mailbox tag slots a layer: gdn ``layer``, the others these + ``layer`` (a
+# layer's two HC fronts share one, each on its own scratch)
+OPROJ_SLOT = moe.TAG_SLOTS // 4
+MOE_SLOT = moe.TAG_SLOTS // 2
+HC_SLOT = 3 * moe.TAG_SLOTS // 4
+
+assert NRED <= OTASKS and E == THREADS and OPROJ_SLOT == L.MAX_LAYERS
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GdnBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int = 2
+    norm_eps: float = 1e-6
+    shuffled: bool = True  # in_proj_qkvz in the ASM FP4 GEMM layout, else Triton's
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OprojBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int = 2
+    oq: bool = False  # out_proj MXFP4
+    og: bool = False  # o_proj's input is core x sigmoid(gate)
+    shuffled: bool = True  # with oq: the ASM FP4 GEMM layout, else Triton's
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MoeBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int = 2
+
+    @property
+    def u1(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens == 1
+
+    @property
+    def ps(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens >= PS_MIN
+
+
+GDN_ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "x",
+        "w_qkvz",
+        "w_qkvzs",
+        "w_ba",
+        "conv_w",
+        "conv_st",
+        "cs_seq",
+        "cs_dim",
+        "cs_tok",
+        "a_log",
+        "dt_bias",
+        "norm_w",
+        "rstate",
+        "rs_seq",
+        "st_idx",
+        "core",
+        "scratch",
+        "epoch",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
+OPROJ_ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "core",
+        "gate",
+        "w_o",
+        "w_os",
+        "out",
+        "state",
+        "inj",
+        "msq_out",
+        "peers",
+        "rank",
+        "epoch",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
+MOE_ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "x",
+        "w_gate",
+        "w_sg",
+        "w13",
+        "w13s",
+        "w2",
+        "w2s",
+        "out",
+        "state",
+        "inj",
+        "msq_out",
+        "scratch",
+        "peers",
+        "rank",
+        "epoch",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
+
+
+def fp4_scale_shape(rows: int, k: int, shuffled: bool) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """An MXFP4 linear's scales: [rows, K / 32] swizzled for the ASM FP4 GEMM,
+    else transposed [K / 32, rows] for the Triton FP4 GEMM."""
+    return (rows, QL.scale_cols(k)) if shuffled else (k // 32, rows)
+
+
+def gdn_scratch_layout(key: GdnBuild) -> dict:
+    s, lay = key.tokens, L.Layout(key.tp)
+    return pair_layout(
+        {
+            "proj": s * lay.QKVZ,
+            "qk": s * lay.NK * 2 * HD,
+            "onrm": s * lay.NV * NVCH,
+            "bapart": P.ba_tasks(lay) * s * ROWS,
+        }.items()
+    )
+
+
+def moe_scratch_layout(key: MoeBuild) -> dict:
+    s, lay = key.tokens, L.Layout(key.tp)
+    return pair_layout(
+        {
+            "rlog": s * E // 2,
+            "sgate": s,
+            "route": s * 2 * TOPK,
+            "inter": s * KT * moe.inter_pairs(lay.moe),
+        }.items()
+    )
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(layout: dict) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in layout.values())
+
+
+PEER_REGIONS = ("ar", "final")
+
+
+def peer_layout(s, tp):
+    """One parity's peer regions: the o_proj and MoE partials of every rank."""
+    return pair_layout({r: tp * s * H // 2 for r in PEER_REGIONS}.items())
+
+
+def peer_bytes(s, tp):
+    """The peer buffer: both parities' regions at ``s`` rows."""
+    return 2 * scratch_bytes(peer_layout(s, tp))
+
+
+def _peers(peers, rank, epoch, tp):
+    """The peer regions at the widest width, this step's parity half: every
+    rank's and this rank's own."""
+    play = peer_layout(MAXT, tp)
+    half = peer_bytes(MAXT, tp) // 2
+    par = uniform(ld_i32(epoch, 0)) % 2
+    bases = peer_bases(peers, tp)
+    own = load_ptr64(peers, rank)
+    peer = {}
+    for region in PEER_REGIONS:
+        off = play[region][0]
+        peer[region] = [
+            shift(preg(b, off, region), fx.Int64(par) * half) for b in bases
+        ]
+        peer[region + "_own"] = shift(preg(own, off, region), fx.Int64(par) * half)
+    return peer
+
+
+def _inj_of(c):
+    """The injection logits the block's HC front wrote ([S, HC] bf16)."""
+
+    def get(t):
+        w = fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(rsrc(c["args"]["inj_a"]), t * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32)
+        )
+        return [bf_lo(w[0]), bf_hi(w[0]), bf_lo(w[1]), bf_hi(w[1])]
+
+    return get
+
+
+def stage_out(c, j, own, out):
+    """The block's TP all-reduce at peer region ``own``, then the HC combine of
+    the input ``state`` [S, HC H] and ``inj_a`` [S, HC] -> ``out`` [S, HC H] +
+    ``msq_out`` [NRED, S, HC]."""
+    a = c["args"]
+
+    def msq_put(jj, t, k, v):
+        bo.buffer_store(v, rsrc(a["msq_out"]), (jj * c["S"] + t) * L.HC + k)
+
+    hc.stage_combine(c, j, own, _inj_of(c), a["state"], 0, out, 0, msq_put)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gdn
+_GDN: dict = {}
+
+
+def build_gdn(key: GdnBuild):
+    if key in _GDN:
+        return _GDN[key]
+    s = key.tokens
+    need(1 <= s <= MAXT, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{MAXT}")
+    lay = L.Layout(key.tp)
+    scr = gdn_scratch_layout(key)
+    nr = -(-s * P.gdn_tasks_of(lay) // BLOCKS)
+    nba = P.ba_tasks(lay)
+    need(P.BA0 + nba <= BLOCKS, "in_proj_ba's CTAs")
+    need(lay.QKVZ // ROWS == 2 * BLOCKS, "in_proj_qkvz: two row groups a CTA")
+    xwords = s * XROW // 2
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class XLds:
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, xwords, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class GdnLds:
+        qkl: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * 2 * HD, 16]
+        vloc: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * VCH, 16]
+        ol: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * VCH, 16]
+        scal: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * 4, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class StageLds:
+        x: XLds
+        gdn: GdnLds
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+
+    @flyc.kernel(
+        name=f"flashnext_split_gdn_s{s}_t{key.tp}_w{int(key.shuffled)}",
+        known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )
+    def kgdn(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvzs: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        conv_w: Int64,
+        conv_st: Int64,
+        cs_seq: Int32,
+        cs_dim: Int32,
+        cs_tok: Int32,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        rstate: Int64,
+        rs_seq: Int32,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        lds = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        st_lds = alloc.allocate(StageLds)
+        xl, gl = st_lds.x.peek(), st_lds.gdn.peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1, health, alarm, region_ids(scr))
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "lay": lay,
+            "gdn": lay.gdn,
+            "shuffled": key.shuffled,
+            "ba_of": P.ba_of,
+            "ba_parts": P.BA_PARTS,
+            "z_gate": sigmoid,
+            "goff": P.gdn_offset(s, key.tp),
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "norm_eps": key.norm_eps,
+            "put": mb.put,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "xl": xl.xl.ptr,
+            "qkl": gl.qkl.ptr,
+            "vloc": gl.vloc.ptr,
+            "ol": gl.ol.ptr,
+            "scal": gl.scal.ptr,
+            "args": {
+                "w_qkvz": w_qkvz,
+                "w_qkvzs": w_qkvzs,
+                "w_ba": w_ba,
+                "conv_w": conv_w,
+                "conv_st": conv_st,
+                "cs_seq": cs_seq,
+                "cs_dim": cs_dim,
+                "cs_tok": cs_tok,
+                "a_log": a_log,
+                "dt_bias": dt_bias,
+                "norm_w": norm_w,
+                "rstate": rstate,
+                "rs_seq": rs_seq,
+                "st_idx": st_idx,
+                "core": core,
+            },
+        }
+        for region in ("proj", "qk", "onrm", "bapart"):
+            c[region] = sreg(scratch, scr[region][0], region)
+        qops = [P.qkvz_loads(c, bid + BLOCKS * j) for j in range(2)]
+        is_ba = (bid >= P.BA0) & (bid < P.BA0 + nba)
+        if is_ba:
+            bops = G.ba_loads(c, bid - P.BA0, P.BA_PARTS, P.BA_K)
+            gemv.rows_to_lds(tid, x, H, s, c["xl"], XROW)
+            G.stage_ba(c, bid - P.BA0, bops, P.BA_PARTS, P.BA_K)
+        if ~is_ba:
+            gemv.rows_to_lds(tid, x, H, s, c["xl"], XROW)
+        quant_x(c, H)
+        for j in range_constexpr(2):
+            P.stage_qkvz(c, bid + BLOCKS * j, qops[j])
+        gdn_tasks(c, nr)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvzs: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        conv_w: Int64,
+        conv_st: Int64,
+        cs_seq: Int32,
+        cs_dim: Int32,
+        cs_tok: Int32,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        rstate: Int64,
+        rs_seq: Int32,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kgdn(
+            x,
+            w_qkvz,
+            w_qkvzs,
+            w_ba,
+            conv_w,
+            conv_st,
+            cs_seq,
+            cs_dim,
+            cs_tok,
+            a_log,
+            dt_bias,
+            norm_w,
+            rstate,
+            rs_seq,
+            st_idx,
+            core,
+            scratch,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    GDN_ABI.check(kgdn, launch)
+    _GDN[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def gdn_block(
+    key: GdnBuild,
+    *,
+    x,
+    w_qkvz,
+    w_qkvzs,
+    w_ba,
+    conv_w,
+    conv_state,
+    a_log,
+    dt_bias,
+    norm_w,
+    rstate,
+    st_idx,
+    core,
+    scratch,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+):
+    """A GDN layer's ``linear_attn`` up to out_proj's input: ``x`` [S, H] bf16
+    (the block input) -> ``core`` [S, CORE] bf16. Every weight as vLLM holds
+    it after loading (in_proj_qkvz online MXFP4 with e8m0 scales, in the
+    layout of the FP4 GEMM AITER picked: ``key.shuffled``). ``conv_state``
+    [slots, CONV, 3] or a transposed view of [slots, 3, CONV] (strides read);
+    ``rstate`` [slots, NV, 128, 128] fp32, a slot dense, slots strided;
+    ``st_idx`` [>= S] int32, <= 0 a pad row (no state written, a zero core
+    row); ``epoch`` a device int32 bumped once a step, ``layer`` this
+    launch's tag slot."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    lay = L.Layout(key.tp)
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    need(x.shape == (s, H) and x.dtype == bf and x.is_contiguous(), "x: bf16 [S, H]")
+    need(
+        core.shape == (s, lay.CORE) and core.dtype == bf, f"core: bf16 [S, {lay.CORE}]"
+    )
+    need(
+        w_qkvz.shape == (lay.QKVZ, H // 2)
+        and w_qkvz.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2),
+        f"in_proj_qkvz: fp4x2 [{lay.QKVZ}, {H // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w_qkvzs.shape == fp4_scale_shape(lay.QKVZ, H, key.shuffled)
+        and w_qkvzs.element_size() == 1,
+        "in_proj_qkvz scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, in the weight's layout",
+    )
+    need(
+        w_ba.shape == (lay.BA, H) and w_ba.dtype == bf,
+        f"in_proj_ba: bf16 [{lay.BA}, {H}]",
+    )
+    need(conv_w.numel() == lay.CONV * L.CONV_W and conv_w.dtype == bf, "conv1d weight")
+    need(
+        conv_state.dtype == bf and conv_state.shape[1:] == (lay.CONV, P.SL),
+        f"conv state: bf16 [slots, {lay.CONV}, 3]",
+    )
+    need(
+        rstate.dtype == torch.float32 and rstate.shape[1:] == (lay.NV, HD, HD),
+        f"recurrent state: fp32 [slots, {lay.NV}, 128, 128]",
+    )
+    need(rstate[0].is_contiguous(), "a recurrent state slot must be dense")
+    need(a_log.dtype == torch.float32 and dt_bias.dtype == bf, "A_log / dt_bias dtype")
+    need(norm_w.dtype == bf and norm_w.numel() == HD, "gated norm weight")
+    need(st_idx.dtype == torch.int32 and st_idx.numel() >= s, "state indices")
+    need(
+        all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (w_qkvz, w_qkvzs, w_ba, conv_w, core)),
+        "a non-contiguous GDN input",
+    )
+    vals = {
+        "x": x.data_ptr(),
+        "w_qkvz": w_qkvz.data_ptr(),
+        "w_qkvzs": w_qkvzs.data_ptr(),
+        "w_ba": w_ba.data_ptr(),
+        "conv_w": conv_w.data_ptr(),
+        "conv_st": conv_state.data_ptr(),
+        "cs_seq": conv_state.stride(0),
+        "cs_dim": conv_state.stride(1),
+        "cs_tok": conv_state.stride(2),
+        "a_log": a_log.data_ptr(),
+        "dt_bias": dt_bias.data_ptr(),
+        "norm_w": norm_w.data_ptr(),
+        "rstate": rstate.data_ptr(),
+        "rs_seq": rstate.stride(0),
+        "st_idx": st_idx.data_ptr(),
+        "core": core.data_ptr(),
+        "scratch": scratch.data_ptr(),
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build_gdn(key)(*GDN_ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- oproj
+_OPROJ: dict = {}
+
+
+def build_oproj(key: OprojBuild):
+    if key in _OPROJ:
+        return _OPROJ[key]
+    s, tp = key.tokens, key.tp
+    need(1 <= s <= MAXT, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{MAXT}")
+    lay = L.Layout(tp)
+    xwords = s * (lay.CORE + gemv.LDS_PAD) // 2
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, xwords, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+    name = (
+        f"flashnext_split_oproj_s{s}_t{tp}_o{int(key.oq)}_a{int(key.og)}"
+        f"_w{int(key.shuffled)}"
+    )
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def koproj(
+        core: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        w_o: Int64,
+        w_os: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        state: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        msq_out: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(
+            step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1, health, alarm, region_ids(PEER_REGIONS)
+        )
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "TP": tp,
+            "lay": lay,
+            "moe": lay.moe,
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "rank": rank,
+            "oq": key.oq,
+            "og": key.og,
+            "shuffled": key.shuffled,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "xl": lds.xl.ptr,
+            "peer": _peers(peers, rank, epoch, tp),
+            "args": {
+                "core": core,
+                "gate": gate,
+                "w_o": w_o,
+                "w_os": w_os,
+                "state": state,
+                "inj_a": inj,
+                "msq_out": msq_out,
+            },
+        }
+        if bid < OTASKS:
+            oops = moe.o_loads(c, bid, lay.CORE)
+            moe.run_oproj(c, [oops], lay.CORE)
+        if bid < NRED:
+            stage_out(c, bid, c["peer"]["ar_own"], out)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        core: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        w_o: Int64,
+        w_os: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        state: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        msq_out: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        koproj(
+            core,
+            gate,
+            w_o,
+            w_os,
+            out,
+            state,
+            inj,
+            msq_out,
+            peers,
+            rank,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    OPROJ_ABI.check(koproj, launch)
+    _OPROJ[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def _hc_vals(key, out, state, inj, msq_out) -> dict:
+    """The HC combine's tensors -> their ABI values."""
+    s, bf = key.tokens, torch.bfloat16
+    need(
+        out.shape == state.shape == (s, L.HH) and out.dtype == state.dtype == bf,
+        "out, state: bf16 [S, HC H]",
+    )
+    need(inj.shape == (s, L.HC) and inj.dtype == bf, "inj: bf16 [S, HC]")
+    need(
+        msq_out.shape == (NRED, s, L.HC) and msq_out.dtype == torch.float32,
+        "msq_out: fp32 [NRED, S, HC]",
+    )
+    need(all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (state, inj, msq_out)), "a non-contiguous HC")
+    return {
+        "state": state.data_ptr(),
+        "inj": inj.data_ptr(),
+        "msq_out": msq_out.data_ptr(),
+    }
+
+
+def oproj_block(
+    key: OprojBuild,
+    *,
+    core,
+    w_o,
+    state,
+    inj,
+    out,
+    msq_out,
+    peers,
+    rank,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+    w_os=None,
+    gate=None,
+):
+    """``out_proj`` / ``o_proj``, its TP all-reduce and the attention HC's
+    combine: ``core`` [S, CORE] bf16 (x sigmoid(``gate``) with ``key.og``) ->
+    the sum over the ranks, combined into ``state`` [S, HC H] with the
+    injection logits ``inj`` [S, HC] -> ``out`` [S, HC H] and its sums of
+    squares ``msq_out`` [NRED, S, HC] fp32. ``w_o`` as vLLM
+    holds it after loading (``key.oq``: fp4x2 with e8m0 ``w_os``, in the
+    layout of the FP4 GEMM AITER picked: ``key.shuffled``)."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    k = L.Layout(key.tp).CORE
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    need(core.shape == (s, k) and core.dtype == bf, f"core: bf16 [{s}, {k}]")
+    hcv = _hc_vals(key, out, state, inj, msq_out)
+    need(
+        (gate is not None) == key.og and (gate is None or gate.shape == core.shape),
+        "gate: core's shape, with og only",
+    )
+    if key.oq:
+        need(
+            w_o.shape == (H, k // 2)
+            and w_os is not None
+            and w_os.shape == fp4_scale_shape(H, k, key.shuffled)
+            and w_os.element_size() == 1,
+            f"o_proj: fp4x2 [{H}, {k // 2}] + e8m0 scales in its layout",
+        )
+    else:
+        need(w_o.shape == (H, k) and w_o.dtype == bf, f"o_proj: bf16 [{H}, {k}]")
+    used = [t for t in (core, gate, w_o, w_os, out) if t is not None]
+    need(all(t.is_contiguous() for t in used), "a non-contiguous input")
+    vals = {
+        "core": core.data_ptr(),
+        "gate": 0 if gate is None else gate.data_ptr(),
+        "w_o": w_o.data_ptr(),
+        "w_os": w_os.data_ptr() if key.oq else 0,
+        "out": out.data_ptr(),
+        **hcv,
+        "peers": peers.data_ptr(),
+        "rank": rank,
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build_oproj(key)(*OPROJ_ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- moe
+_MOE: dict = {}
+
+
+@traced
+def _x_to_lds(c, missing):
+    if missing:
+        gemv.rows_to_lds(c["tid"], c["args"]["x"], H, c["S"], c["xl"], XROW)
+
+
+def build_moe(key: MoeBuild):
+    if key in _MOE:
+        return _MOE[key]
+    s, tp = key.tokens, key.tp
+    need(1 <= s <= MAXT, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{MAXT}")
+    lay = L.Layout(tp)
+    scr = moe_scratch_layout(key)
+    xwords = s * XROW // 2
+    max_u = s * TOPK + 1  # distinct experts the step can touch + the fused shared
+    need(PS0 + lay.RI // moe.UG_COLS <= BLOCKS, "the shared expert's early ug CTAs")
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class RouteLds:
+        route: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * 2 * KT, 16]
+        flag: fx.Array[fx.Int32, E, 16]
+        expert: fx.Array[fx.Int32, max_u, 16]
+        kof: fx.Array[fx.Int32, max_u * s, 16]
+        scan: fx.Array[fx.Int32, WAVES, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class XLds:
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, xwords, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class DownLds:
+        il: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * KT * (moe.irow(lay.moe) // 4 + lay.RIP // 32), 16]
+        contrib: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * KT * ROWS, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class StageLds:
+        x: XLds
+        down: DownLds
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+
+    @flyc.kernel(
+        name=f"flashnext_split_moe_s{s}_t{tp}",
+        known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )
+    def kmoe(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w_sg: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        state: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        msq_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        lds = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        rl = alloc.allocate(RouteLds).peek()
+        st_lds = alloc.allocate(StageLds)
+        xl, dl = st_lds.x.peek(), st_lds.down.peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(
+            step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1, health, alarm, region_ids((*scr, *PEER_REGIONS))
+        )
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "TP": tp,
+            "lay": lay,
+            "moe": lay.moe,
+            "route_cta": RT0,
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "rank": rank,
+            "oq": False,
+            "og": False,
+            "shuffled": True,
+            "u1": key.u1,
+            "KT": KT,
+            "kof_t": s,
+            "max_u": max_u,
+            "put": mb.put,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "put_words": mb.put_words,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "peer": _peers(peers, rank, epoch, tp),
+            "xl": xl.xl.ptr,
+            "il": dl.il.ptr,
+            "contrib": dl.contrib.ptr,
+            "rt": {
+                "route": rl.route.ptr,
+                "flag": rl.flag.ptr,
+                "expert": rl.expert.ptr,
+                "kof": rl.kof.ptr,
+                "scan": rl.scan.ptr,
+            },
+            "args": {
+                "x": x,
+                "w_gate": w_gate,
+                "w_sg": w_sg,
+                "w13": w13,
+                "w13s": w13s,
+                "w2": w2,
+                "w2s": w2s,
+                "state": state,
+                "inj_a": inj,
+                "msq_out": msq_out,
+            },
+        }
+        for region in ("rlog", "sgate", "route", "inter"):
+            c[region] = sreg(scratch, scr[region][0], region)
+        rlog = c["rlog"]
+        c["rlog_at"] = lambda t, lane, i: (rlog, (t * E + lane + 64 * i) // 2, 1)
+        c["rlog_last"] = (1, lambda i: (rlog, (s * E - 2) // 2, 1))
+        is_r = (bid >= R0) & (bid < RT0)
+        is_g = (bid >= RT0) & (bid < RT0 + s)
+        if is_r:
+            rops = R.router_loads(c, bid - R0)
+            _x_to_lds(c, is_r)
+            R.stage_router(c, bid - R0, rops)
+        if is_g:
+            _x_to_lds(c, is_g)
+            R.stage_sgate(c, bid - RT0)
+        nu = moe.run_ug(c, key.ps, PS0, lambda: _x_to_lds(c, ~(is_r | is_g)))
+        if bid < OTASKS:
+            dops = moe.down_loads(c, bid, nu, fx.min(c["wave"], nu - 1))
+            moe.load_inter(c)
+            moe.stage_down(c, bid, nu, dops)
+        if bid < NRED:
+            stage_out(c, bid, c["peer"]["final_own"], out)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w_sg: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        state: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        msq_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kmoe(
+            x,
+            w_gate,
+            w_sg,
+            w13,
+            w13s,
+            w2,
+            w2s,
+            out,
+            state,
+            inj,
+            msq_out,
+            scratch,
+            peers,
+            rank,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    MOE_ABI.check(kmoe, launch)
+    _MOE[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def moe_block(
+    key: MoeBuild,
+    *,
+    x,
+    w_gate,
+    w_sg,
+    w13,
+    w13s,
+    w2,
+    w2s,
+    state,
+    inj,
+    out,
+    msq_out,
+    scratch,
+    peers,
+    rank,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+):
+    """The sparse MoE block, its TP all-reduce and the MLP HC's combine: ``x``
+    [S, H] bf16 -> the sum over the ranks, combined into ``state`` with ``inj``
+    as ``oproj_block`` does. The routed experts as the AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4
+    backend holds them after loading (shuffled, e8m0 scales), the shared
+    expert fused as expert 512."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    lay = L.Layout(key.tp)
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    fp4s = (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+    ne = E + 1
+    need(x.shape == (s, H) and x.dtype == bf, "x: bf16 [S, H]")
+    hcv = _hc_vals(key, out, state, inj, msq_out)
+    need(w_gate.shape == (E, H) and w_sg.numel() == H, "router shape")
+    need(
+        w13.shape == (ne, 2 * lay.RIP, H // 2) and w13.dtype in fp4s,
+        f"w13: fp4x2 [{ne}, {2 * lay.RIP}, {H // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w2.shape == (ne, H, lay.RIP // 2) and w2.dtype in fp4s,
+        f"w2: fp4x2 [{ne}, {H}, {lay.RIP // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w13s.numel() == ne * 2 * lay.RIP * QL.scale_cols(H)
+        and w13s.element_size() == 1,
+        "w13 scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, shuffled",
+    )
+    need(
+        w2s.numel() == ne * H * QL.scale_cols(lay.RIP) and w2s.element_size() == 1,
+        "w2 scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, shuffled (K blocks padded to 8)",
+    )
+    tensors = [x, out, w_gate, w_sg, w13, w13s, w2, w2s]
+    need(all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors), "a non-contiguous input")
+    need(all(t.dtype == bf for t in (w_gate, w_sg)), "router weights: bf16")
+    vals = {
+        "x": x.data_ptr(),
+        "w_gate": w_gate.data_ptr(),
+        "w_sg": w_sg.data_ptr(),
+        "w13": w13.data_ptr(),
+        "w13s": w13s.data_ptr(),
+        "w2": w2.data_ptr(),
+        "w2s": w2s.data_ptr(),
+        "out": out.data_ptr(),
+        **hcv,
+        "scratch": scratch.data_ptr(),
+        "peers": peers.data_ptr(),
+        "rank": rank,
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build_moe(key)(*MOE_ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())

+"""Wait records: which mailbox region a CTA's given-up wait was on."""
+
+import zlib
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import RECORD_WORDS
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import BLOCKS
+
+
+def region_id(name: str) -> int:
+    """A mailbox region's id in a wait record: its name's CRC-32 (31 bits), the
+    same in every kernel and table that names it."""
+    return zlib.crc32(name.encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF
+
+
+def region_ids(names) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Name -> ``region_id``: a ``Mailbox``'s table."""
+    return {n: region_id(n) for n in names}
+
+
+def given_up_waits(health: torch.Tensor, names) -> list[str]:
+    """Each CTA's first wait that gave up, the earliest first, from a rank's
+    ``health`` words; ``names`` the regions a record may name."""
+    by_id = {region_id(n): n for n in names}
+    records = health.view(BLOCKS + 1, RECORD_WORDS)[1:]
+    records = records[records[:, 0] != 0].tolist()
+    t0 = min((r[6] for r in records), default=0)
+    return [
+        f"+{(at - t0) / 100:.0f} us CTA {cta}: {by_id.get(rid, rid)} pair {idx}"
+        f" waited for tag {tag}, saw {seen}"
+        for _, rid, idx, tag, seen, cta, at, _ in sorted(records, key=lambda r: r[6])
+    ]

+"""Device-side primitives of the mono kernels: wave reductions and shuffles, the
+approximate hardware math, bf16 packing, buffer resources, the
+execution-model constants and the kernel symbol naming.
+
+Ported from the FlyDSL GLM-5 layer kernel (ROCm/FlyDSL branch
+``glm5-mla-moe-layer-monokernel`` @ 1e28fd8a,
+``kernels/mla_moe_layer/shared_reuse_moe_kernel.py``). Only published flydsl APIs
+and aiter's vendored ``buffer_ops`` / ``dpp_utils`` are used.
+
+Every function but ``kernel_symbol`` is traced inside a ``@flyc.kernel`` body.
+
+Raw boundaries kept, for want of an equivalent on the pinned FlyDSL:
+``buffer_ops`` loads / stores (the kernels take raw Int64 addresses, no tensors
+for ``make_buffer_tensor``); raw MFMA intrinsics (hand-laid operands: permlane
+transposes, MXFP4 scales); the LLVM intrinsics here
+(``s_memrealtime``, the approximate rsq / exp2) and the struct unpacking of
+``permlane*_swap``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.kernels_common import kernel_signature
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.compiler.ast_rewriter import ASTRewriter
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import THREADS, WAVES
+
+# gfx95x cache policy bits (LLVM CPol): SC0 = 1, SC1 = 16. SC1 alone is device
+# scope (past the per-XCD caches); SC0 | SC1 is system scope (peers over XGMI).
+CM_DEV = 16
+
+
+CM_SYS = 17
+
+
+# NT = 2: nontemporal. A weight a layer reads once streams past the caches it
+# would only evict the step's reused data from (K2b at 48 rows: 143 -> 133 us)
+CM_NT = 2
+
+
+def kernel_symbol(stem, **params):
+    """Kernel symbol that profilers demangle to ``atom::<stem>_<params>``. The
+    amdhsa assembler rejects ``::`` in a symbol, so it is Itanium-mangled, as
+    aiter's ``_ZN5aiter...E`` kernels are."""
+    name = f"{stem}_{kernel_signature(**params)}"
+    return f"_ZN4atom{len(name)}{name}E"
+
+
+def rsrc(addr, nbytes=None):
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(addr, num_records_bytes=nbytes)

+
+def permlane_swap(off, x, y):
+    """v_permlane{32,16}_swap on registers (x, y): off 32 trades x's upper-half
+    lanes with y's lower-half lanes; off 16 trades x's odd 16-lane rows with y's
+    even rows (each within its half). -> (x', y')."""
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if off == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pr = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(x)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(y)),
+        False,
+        False,
+    )
+    return tuple(fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, pr, [j])) for j in range(2))

+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v, a source lane a lane (ds_bpermute)."""
+    return fx.Int32(

+    )

+def readlane(v, src_lane):
+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v (wave-uniform)."""
+    bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+    r = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, bits, fx.Int32(src_lane)))
+    return r.bitcast(fx.Float32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else r

+def memrealtime():
+    """s_memrealtime: the 100 MHz device clock (no FlyDSL wrapper)."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))

+
+def uniform(v):

+
+def _hw_f32(name, x):

+        llvm.call_intrinsic(T.f32, name, [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], [])
+    )

+def hw_rsq(x):

+    q = x * r
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(fx.Float32(fmath.fma(-q, d, x)), r, q))

+    assert off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), off
+    if off >= 16:

+    else:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    return y.bitcast(fx.Float32) if is_f else y
+
+
+def xred(v, off, op):
+    """op(v, lane ^ off) for a symmetric op; 32 / 16 take both halves of one swap."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return op(v, xshfl(v, off))
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, x, x)
+    if is_f:
+        return op(a.bitcast(fx.Float32), b.bitcast(fx.Float32))
+    return op(type(v)(a), type(v)(b))
+
+
+def _add(a, b):
+    return a + b
+
+
+def butterfly(v, offsets, op=_add):
+    """Butterfly reduction over the given xor offsets, in the given order.
+
+    The order is the numerical contract: the aiter per-head norm reduces 32
+    lanes with offsets 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, and matching it keeps rstd bit-exact."""
+    for off in offsets:
+        v = xred(v, off, op)
+    return v
+
+
+def wave_sum(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+
+
+def traced(fn):
+    """Apply flydsl's AST rewriting to a helper, so its ``while`` / ``if`` over
+    traced values lower to scf ops. Kernels rewrite only their own body."""
+    return ASTRewriter.transform(fn)
+
+
+def wave_max(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), fx.max)
+
+
+def row_shr(v, lane, k):
+    """DPP row_shr:k of an f32: lane - k of the same 16-lane row, else 0."""
+    moved = lane_gather(v.bitcast(fx.Int32), fx.max(lane - k, 0)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return fx.Float32((lane % 16 >= k).select(moved, fx.Float32(0.0)))
+
+
+def _xpartner(v, off, lane):
+    """Lane ``lane ^ off``'s v: DPP within a row, v_permlane*_swap across rows
+    (``xshfl`` takes ``shuffle_xor`` there)."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return xshfl(v, off)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, v, v)
+    return ((lane & off) != 0).select(a, b)
+
+
+def wave_incl_scan(v, lane):
+    """Inclusive prefix sum of an Int32 over the wave, in lane order."""
+    blk = v
+    for off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
+        o = _xpartner(blk, off, lane)
+        v = v + ((lane & off) != 0).select(o, 0)
+        blk = blk + o
+    return v
+
+
+@traced
+def block_excl_scan(v, lane, wave, buf):
+    """(exclusive prefix of v over the CTA in thread order, CTA total); ``buf``
+    needs WAVES words."""
+    incl = wave_incl_scan(v, lane)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if lane == 63:
+        fx.ptr_store(incl, buf + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    off = fx.Int32(0)
+    tot = fx.Int32(0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+        cnt = fx.ptr_load(buf + w)
+        off = off + (w < wave).select(cnt, 0)
+        tot = tot + cnt
+    return incl - v + off, tot
+
+
+def ld_i32(ptr, i):
+    """Word ``i`` of a buffer, a plain Int32 load."""
+    return fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32))
+
+
+def ld_dev(ptr, i, words=1):
+    """``words`` i32 (1, 2 or 4) of a buffer from word ``i``, at device scope
+    (past the per-XCD L2)."""
+    return bo.buffer_load(
+        rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=words, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+    )
+
+
+LOAD_BATCH = 4  # rounds of a strided loop whose loads go out together
+
+
+@traced
+def batched_rounds(tid, n, load, use, batch=LOAD_BATCH):
+    """A CTA's strided loop over elements v = tid + THREADS i < n (n a Python
+    int): ``load(v)`` of ``batch`` rounds issued before any ``use(v, loaded)``.
+    A round whose ``use`` stores to global memory keeps the next round's loads
+    behind it (they may alias), so the rounds' loads would go out in series. A
+    round past n loads element n - 1 (in range) and uses nothing."""
+    rounds = -(-n // THREADS)
+    for b0 in range_constexpr(0, rounds, batch):
+        idx = range(b0, min(b0 + batch, rounds))
+        got = [load(fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)) for i in idx]
+        for i, g in zip(idx, got):
+            v = tid + THREADS * i
+            if v < n:
+                use(v, g)
+
+
+def rows_to_lds(tid, src, rows, row_words, dst, dst_row):
+    """``rows`` rows of ``row_words`` words (a multiple of 4) read at device scope
+    from address ``src`` -> LDS ``dst``, a row every ``dst_row`` words: 16 B a
+    lane, the loads batched (``batched_rounds``)."""
+    assert row_words % 4 == 0, row_words
+    batched_rounds(
+        tid, rows * row_words // 4,
+        lambda v: fx.Vector(ld_dev(src, v * 4, 4)),
+        lambda v, w: fx.ptr_store(
+            w, dst + (v * 4 // row_words * dst_row + v * 4 % row_words)
+        ),
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def mfma_bf16(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c]))
+
+
+def row_sum(red, r, t, waves=None):
+    """Row r, token t of the waves' 16x16 MFMA accumulators (wave w's at ``red``
+    + (w * 64 + lane) * 4), summed in wave order from 0 (``waves``: which, in
+    order; all of them by default)."""
+    tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in waves if waves is not None else range(WAVES):
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+    return tot
+
+
+def ballot(pred):
+    """The wave's lanes where ``pred`` holds, a bit a lane."""
+    return fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, as_ir_value(pred)))
+
+
+def load_ptr64(table, i):
+    """Entry ``i`` of an i64 table in memory, wave-uniform (each half through
+    ``uniform``): a peer's buffer base, a kernel argument block's pointer."""
+    pw = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(table), i * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32))
+    return (fx.Int64(uniform(pw[1])) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(uniform(pw[0])))
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf16_pair(a, b):
+    """Two f32 -> one f32-typed word holding (bf16(a), bf16(b))."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Float32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (w << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's high half."""
+    return (w & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf2_f32(w):
+    """Packed bf16 pair word -> (f32 low, f32 high)."""
+    return bf_lo(w), bf_hi(w)

+# atom/mono/plan/layout.py
+# atom/mono/runtime/abi.py
+"""A kernel build's parameters, all of them in FlyDSL's JIT cache key.
+
+FlyDSL keys a compiled kernel by the scalar values (int, float, bool, str, enum,
+tuple) its launcher's closures capture; an object in a closure is not keyed, and
+a parameter used only by build-time Python (a placement table, a layout) is in no
+closure at all. Two builds differing only there would share one binary -- every
+TP rank ran rank 3's kernel once that way. So a build's parameters are one frozen
+dataclass of scalars, ``key_tuple`` turns it into one (name, value) tuple, and the
+launcher references that tuple: every field is keyed, whatever the body uses.
+
+The tuple also carries the model's kernel sources (``source_digest``): FlyDSL
+keys a helper's source only when its walk reaches it, and it does not reach a
+helper called inside a traced function's dynamic loop or branch (the rewriter
+moves those bodies into nested functions it does not scan) nor one outside the
+kernel's directory -- an edit there kept the old binary.
+"""
+
+import enum
+import functools
+import hashlib
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import health_words
+
+_SCALARS = (int, float, bool, str, enum.Enum)
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def source_digest() -> str:
+    """sha256 of every ``.py`` file of the ``mono`` package, each file's path and
+    contents."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for f in sorted(_ROOT.rglob("*.py")):
+        h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())
+        h.update(f.read_bytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def key_tuple(key, sources: str) -> tuple:
+    """``key``'s (field name, value) pairs, every value a scalar, then
+    ("sources", ``sources``): the model's ``source_digest``."""
+    out = []
+    for f in fields(key):
+        value = getattr(key, f.name)
+        if not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"{type(key).__name__}.{f.name} = {value!r}: a build parameter must be"
+                " a scalar to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((f.name, value))
+    out.append(("sources", sources))
+    return tuple(out)
+
+
+# The execution model every mono kernel is written for.
+#
+# One CTA per CU of an MI355X, all of them co-resident -- a spin wait on another
+# CTA can only make progress if that CTA is running, so the runner refuses a GPU
+# with another CU count -- and THREADS threads each.
+#
+
+BLOCKS = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+
+
+# A kernel's mailbox regions laid out in its scratch or peer buffer.
+
+PAIR_BYTES = 8  # a (value, tag) pair
+# A rank's health words (``mono.abi``), for this grid.
+HEALTH_WORDS = health_words(BLOCKS)
+
+
+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """``items`` (name, pairs) laid out in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes),
+    each region from an ``align``-byte boundary at or past ``start``."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+
+
+# A kernel's argument list, named once.
+#
+# A FlyDSL kernel and its launcher each spell out their positional parameters, and
+# the host passes them by position: an argument out of order is a pointer read as
+# another, silently. ``KernelAbi`` is the one list of names; the build checks the
+# kernel's and the launcher's parameters against it, and the host packs by name.
+#
+
+
+def _python_params(fn) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Parameter names of a ``@flyc.kernel`` / ``@flyc.jit`` object's Python
+    function (FlyDSL keeps it as ``_func`` / ``func``)."""
+    py = getattr(fn, "func", None) or getattr(fn, "_func", None)
+    if py is None:
+        raise TypeError(f"no Python function behind {fn!r}")
+    return tuple(inspect.signature(py).parameters)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KernelAbi:
+    names: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def check(self, kernel, launcher) -> None:
+        """The kernel takes exactly ``names``; the launcher too, then ``stream``."""
+        got = _python_params(kernel)
+        if got != self.names:
+            raise TypeError(f"kernel parameters {got} != ABI {self.names}")
+        got = _python_params(launcher)
+        if got != (*self.names, "stream"):
+            raise TypeError(f"launcher parameters {got} != ABI {self.names} + stream")
+
+    def pack(self, values: dict) -> list:
+        """``values`` (every name, nothing else) in ABI order."""
+        try:
+            if len(values) == len(self.names):
+                return [values[n] for n in self.names]
+        except KeyError:
+            pass
+        extra = sorted(set(values) - set(self.names))
+        missing = sorted(set(self.names) - set(values))
+        raise TypeError(f"ABI mismatch: missing {missing}, unexpected {extra}")
+
+    def zeros(self) -> list:
+        """Every argument 0: what a compile-only call passes."""
+        return [0] * len(self.names)
+
+
+class Space(Enum):
+    SCRATCH = "scratch"  # this GPU's memory: device-scope hand-off between CTAs
+    PEER = "peer"  # a peer-symmetric region: system-scope hand-off between GPUs

+# atom/mono/device/ranks.py
+"""A TP group seen from inside a kernel: every rank's peer buffer, and an
+all-reduce's sum of the ranks' partials. ``tp`` is a build-time constant."""
+
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf2_f32,
+    load_ptr64,
+)
+
+
+def peer_bases(peers, tp):
+    """Every rank's peer buffer base from the ``peers`` table (an i64 a rank),
+    loaded once: a put's address must not wait on a load of its own."""
+    return [load_ptr64(peers, p) for p in range(tp)]
+
+
+def sum_partials(poll, own, pair_of, tp):
+    """The ``tp`` ranks' bf16 pair partials at ``pair_of(src)`` of the mailbox
+    region ``own``, summed in fp32 in rank order 0 .. tp - 1: one poll batch ->
+    (lo sum, hi sum). Every rank sums in the same order, so they agree."""
+    ws = poll([(own, pair_of(src), 1) for src in range(tp)])
+    acc0, acc1 = bf2_f32(ws[0][0])
+    for src in range_constexpr(1, tp):
+        lo, hi = bf2_f32(ws[src][0])
+        acc0 = acc0 + lo
+        acc1 = acc1 + hi
+    return acc0, acc1

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at a526f0d, MIT License,
+# Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.:
+# atom/mono/device/sync.py
+"""The tagged mailbox: hand-offs between the CTAs of one GPU (device scope) and
+between GPUs (system scope), every address a named region (``Addr``)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import (
+    FAILED,
+    RECORD_WORDS,
+    WAIT_SECONDS,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_SYS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    memrealtime,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import Space
+
+POLL_MAX = 12  # mailbox specs polled per batch (bounds live registers)
+
+WAIT_TICKS = WAIT_SECONDS * 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime ticks at 100 MHz
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin(load_all, pending, health, alarm, region_id, index, tag):
+    """Re-issue ``load_all`` until ``pending`` clears, for at most WAIT_TICKS, and
+    not at all once this rank has failed (``health`` word FAILED), so a failed
+    step runs to its end instead of hanging. A side-effecting op in the loop keeps
+    the loads from being hoisted.
+
+    A CTA's first give-up is recorded in its ``health`` record; it then raises the
+    output rank's flag for this rank (``alarm``) and drains that store before it
+    sets FAILED, so no later store of this rank's can overtake the flag."""
+    t0 = memrealtime()
+    v = load_all()
+    why = fx.Int32(0)  # 1: timed out, 2: the rank had failed
+    while pending(v) & (why == 0):
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+        failed = ld_health(health, FAILED) != 0
+        late = memrealtime() - t0 > WAIT_TICKS
+        why = failed.select(fx.Int32(2), late.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)))
+    if why == 1:
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        rec = (bid + 1) * RECORD_WORDS
+        if ld_health(health, rec) == 0:
+            at = fx.Int32(memrealtime() & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+            record = [1, region_id, index, tag, v[1], bid, at, 0]
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):  # 16 B a store
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                        [fx.Int32(w) for w in record[4 * h : 4 * h + 4]], fx.Int32
+                    ),
+                    rsrc(health),
+                    rec + 4 * h,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(alarm), 0, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(health), FAILED, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    return v
+
+
+def ld_health(health, i):
+    return fx.Int32(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(health), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A mailbox region's address: the region's name (a give-up records its id),
+    its space and the traced address. The space sets the hand-off's scope:
+    device for SCRATCH, system for PEER."""
+
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    value: object
+
+
+def sreg(base, offset, region):
+    """Scratch region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.SCRATCH, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def preg(base, offset, region):
+    """Peer-symmetric region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of a rank's buffer
+    ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.PEER, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def shift(a, delta):
+    """``a`` moved by ``delta`` bytes (a traced or Python integer), same region."""
+    return Addr(a.region, a.space, a.value + delta)
+
+
+# the store / load cache policy of a hand-off in each space
+_SCOPE_CM = {Space.SCRATCH: CM_DEV, Space.PEER: CM_SYS}
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Tagged-pair hand-off between CTAs (device scope) and GPUs (system scope).
+
+    Every 32-bit value is stored next to this launch's tag; a consumer
+    polls the payload until all tags match, so a hand-off costs one round trip
+    (no store drain, no separate flag). The tag is ``layer + 1``: it tells the
+    layers of one step apart, and the runner zeroes every mailbox at a step's
+    start (``StepMailboxes.begin_step``), so a pair from an earlier step never
+    carries a live tag. Every address is an ``Addr``: its space picks the scope.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, layer, health, alarm, region_ids):
+        """``health``: this rank's health words (FAILED, then a wait record a
+        CTA); ``alarm``: this rank's flag word on the output rank;
+        ``region_ids``: region name -> the id a record names it by."""
+        self.tag = layer + 1
+        self.health = health
+        self.alarm = alarm
+        self.region_ids = region_ids
+
+    def put(self, a, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, a, i, vs):
+        """Elements i .. i+len(vs) (2 or 4, i aligned) as packed bf16 pairs, one
+        store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, a, i, words):
+        """Raw 32-bit words (1 or 2) at pairs i.. as (word, tag). Integer payloads
+        (fp8 words) must come this way: through an f32 value a NaN bit pattern is
+        not kept."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Batched poll of pairs ``specs`` = [(Addr, pair index, npairs in {1, 2})],
+        all of one space.
+
+        All pairs are re-loaded together while any tag is stale, so a batch costs
+        one round trip after its last producer lands. Returns the value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], batch) + self.poll(specs[batch:], batch)
+        spaces = {a.space for a, _, _ in specs}
+        assert len(spaces) == 1, f"one poll batch spans {spaces}"
+        cm = _SCOPE_CM[spaces.pop()]
+        bases = [a.value for a, _, _ in specs]
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, (_, i, n) in zip(bases, specs):
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=cm,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        rid = self.region_ids.get(specs[0][0].region, -1)
+        v = _spin(load_all, pending, self.health, self.alarm, rid, specs[0][1], tag)
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(put, a, i, v, who):
+    """This CTA's plain stores made readable by every CTA, then (thread ``who``)
+    the mailbox pair (``a``, i) := v. The stores are drained first: a flag may
+    not overtake the data it announces, and a workgroup-scope release fence does
+    not wait for them (LLVM's AMDGPU memory model omits vmcnt outside tgsplit
+    mode: the workgroup's waves share one CU, the readers here do not)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if who:
+        put(a, i, v)

+"""The HC front: a ``GatedResidual``'s ``mix`` of the materialized multi-stream
+state as one persistent launch, ``BLOCKS`` x ``THREADS``, S <= ``MAX_TOKENS``:
+
+    msq   (``self_msq``, CTAs 0 .. 19): the state's sums of squares (the
+          model's first layer and the one after a PLE; past them the previous
+          block's combine hands them over as ``msq_in``)
+    down  (``hc.DOWN_TASKS``, CTAs 88 ..): xn of the state, [down; inject]
+          -> LORA and the injection logits -> ``inj_out`` (bf16)
+    up    (``hc.UP_TASKS``, CTAs 0 .. 159): the gate-mix -> ``bin_out``, the
+          block's input
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono import hc
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.debug import region_ids
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf16_pair,
+    rsrc,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    KernelAbi,
+    key_tuple,
+    pair_layout,
+    source_digest,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    Mailbox,
+    sreg,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import need
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.moe import step_tag
+
+H, HH, HC = L.HIDDEN, L.HH, L.HC
+D0 = BLOCKS - hc.DOWN_TASKS  # 88: the down CTAs, to the last
+
+assert hc.UP_TASKS <= BLOCKS and D0 >= 0 and hc.NRED <= hc.UP_TASKS
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FrontBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int = 2
+    self_msq: bool = False  # the state's sums of squares computed here
+    eps: float = 1e-6  # the HC norm
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "state",
+        "msq_in",
+        "hc_w",
+        "w_down",
+        "w_up",
+        "inj_out",
+        "bin_out",
+        "scratch",
+        "epoch",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
+
+
+def scratch_layout(key: FrontBuild) -> dict:
+    return pair_layout(hc.regions(key.tokens).items())
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(key: FrontBuild) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in scratch_layout(key).values())
+
+
+def _put_inj(c, t, r, vs):
+    """The injection rows r, r + 1 of token t -> ``inj_out`` [S, HC] bf16."""
+    bo.buffer_store(
+        bf16_pair(vs[0], vs[1]).bitcast(fx.Int32),
+        rsrc(c["args"]["inj_out"]),
+        (t * HC + r) // 2,
+    )
+
+
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+
+
+def build(key: FrontBuild):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    s = key.tokens
+    need(1 <= s <= L.MAX_TOKENS, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{L.MAX_TOKENS}")
+    scr = scratch_layout(key)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        rs: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * HC, 16]
+        ll: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * hc.LROW // 2, 16]
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * hc.DROW // 2, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+    name = f"flashnext_hc_front_s{s}_t{key.tp}_m{int(key.self_msq)}"
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kfront(
+        state: Int64,
+        msq_in: Int64,
+        hc_w: Int64,
+        w_down: Int64,
+        w_up: Int64,
+        inj_out: Int64,
+        bin_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1, health, alarm, region_ids(scr))
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "eps": key.eps,
+            "put": mb.put,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "rs": lds.rs.ptr,
+            "ll": lds.ll.ptr,
+            "xl": lds.xl.ptr,
+            "args": {"inj_out": inj_out},
+        }
+        c["hc"] = {
+            "state": state,
+            "state_cm": 0,
+            "w_norm": hc_w,
+            "w_down": w_down,
+            "w_up": w_up,
+            "msq": sreg(scratch, scr["msq"][0], "msq"),
+            "msq_in": None if key.self_msq else msq_in,
+            "dpart": sreg(scratch, scr["dpart"][0], "dpart"),
+            "lora": sreg(scratch, scr["lora"][0], "lora"),
+            "bin": bin_out,
+            "inj_out": lambda t, r, vs: _put_inj(c, t, r, vs),
+        }
+        # a CTA's whole sequence in one branch, its weights in flight first
+        if const_expr(key.self_msq):  # noqa: SIM102 (traced: `and` does not combine traced values)
+            if bid < hc.NRED:
+                hc.stage_msq(c, bid)

+            uops = hc.up_loads(c, bid)
+            hc.load_rrms(c)
+            hc.stage_up(c, bid, uops)
+        if (bid >= D0) & (bid < hc.UP_TASKS):
+            dops = hc.down_loads(c, bid - D0)
+            uops = hc.up_loads(c, bid)
+            hc.load_rrms(c)
+            hc.stage_down(c, bid - D0, dops)
+            hc.stage_up(c, bid, uops)
+        if bid >= hc.UP_TASKS:
+            dops = hc.down_loads(c, bid - D0)
+            hc.load_rrms(c)
+            hc.stage_down(c, bid - D0, dops)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        state: Int64,
+        msq_in: Int64,
+        hc_w: Int64,
+        w_down: Int64,
+        w_up: Int64,
+        inj_out: Int64,
+        bin_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kfront(
+            state,
+            msq_in,
+            hc_w,
+            w_down,
+            w_up,
+            inj_out,
+            bin_out,
+            scratch,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    ABI.check(kfront, launch)
+    _BUILDS[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def hc_front(
+    key: FrontBuild,
+    *,
+    state,
+    msq_in,
+    hc_w,
+    w_down,
+    w_up,
+    inj_out,
+    bin_out,
+    scratch,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+):
+    """``GatedResidual.mix`` of ``state`` [S, 4 H] bf16 -> ``bin_out`` [S, H]
+    bf16 (the block's input) and ``inj_out`` [S, 4] bf16 (its injection
+    logits). ``msq_in``: ``state``'s sums of squares [NRED, S, 4] fp32 as the
+    previous block's combine wrote them, None with ``key.self_msq``."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    need(state.shape == (s, HH) and state.dtype == bf, "state: bf16 [S, 4 H]")
+    need(
+        (msq_in is None) == key.self_msq
+        and (
+            msq_in is None
+            or (msq_in.numel() == hc.NRED * s * HC and msq_in.dtype == torch.float32)
+        ),
+        "msq_in: fp32 [20, S, 4], absent with self_msq only",
+    )
+    need(hc_w.shape == (HH,) and hc_w.dtype == bf, "HC norm weight: [4 H]")
+    need(
+        w_down.shape == (L.DOWN_ROWS, HH) and w_down.dtype == bf, "HC down: [336, 4 H]"
+    )
+    need(w_up.shape == (HH, L.LORA) and w_up.dtype == bf, "HC up: [4 H, 320]")
+    need(inj_out.shape == (s, HC) and inj_out.dtype == bf, "inj_out: bf16 [S, 4]")
+    need(bin_out.shape == (s, H) and bin_out.dtype == bf, "bin_out: bf16 [S, H]")
+    tensors = [state, hc_w, w_down, w_up, inj_out, bin_out]
+    tensors += [msq_in] if msq_in is not None else []
+    need(all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors), "a non-contiguous HC input")
+    vals = {
+        "state": state.data_ptr(),
+        "msq_in": 0 if msq_in is None else msq_in.data_ptr(),
+        "hc_w": hc_w.data_ptr(),
+        "w_down": w_down.data_ptr(),
+        "w_up": w_up.data_ptr(),
+        "inj_out": inj_out.data_ptr(),
+        "bin_out": bin_out.data_ptr(),
+        "scratch": scratch.data_ptr(),
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build(key)(*ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
